mapper.select: SELECT ip_id, admin_id, ip_address, ip_type, ip_start, ip_end, description, access_count, last_access_at, expires_at, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at FROM tb_admin_allow_ip WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

SELECT ip_id, admin_id, ip_address, ip_type, ip_start, ip_end, description, access_count, last_access_at, expires_at, use_yn, delete_yn FROM tb_admin_allow_ip WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin_allow_ip SET access_count = COALESCE(access_count, 0) + 1, last_access_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ip_id = #{ipId}
